run_migrate_imports_dry_run: run a dry run to preview import path replacements in a Python file
run_migrate_imports_execute: run the import migration script to replace old fairchem import paths in a directory
run_migrate_imports_single_file: run the import migration script on a single YAML or Python file
refactor_replace_strings_in_file: refactor replace_strings_in_file to support additional file extensions beyond YAML and Python
review_mapping: review the import path mapping dictionary to add new old to new module replacements
